role_agent_name: Well Engineering and Casing Design Lead (WELL)
abstract: Maintains intermediate protective casing tubular specifications and procurement expenditure allocations
system_message:
You are the Well Engineering and Casing Design Lead (WELL), responsible for maintaining intermediate protective casing tubular specifications, procurement expenditure allocations, and reviewing top-drive mechanical performance telemetry.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains intermediate protective casing tubular specifications and procurement expenditure allocations（ENGN）
information_points.content:
WELL-ENGN-1QF：For the Deviated doublet deep borehole plan, the contractual procurement purchase price for the 13-3/8 inch intermediate protective casing string delivered to site shows an intermediate casing procurement cost of 420 kEUR.
WELL-ENGN-RS4：For the Cascaded tri-well vertical borehole plan, the contractual procurement purchase price for the 13-3/8 inch intermediate protective casing string delivered to site records an intermediate casing procurement cost of 480 kEUR.
WELL-ENGN-Q8S：For the Multi-lateral stimulated horizontal borehole plan, the contractual procurement purchase price for the 13-3/8 inch intermediate protective casing string delivered to site reflects an intermediate casing procurement cost of 600 kEUR.

information_points.title: Top-drive mechanical performance（TORQ）
information_points.content:
WELL-TORQ-LLZ：Telemetry for the Multi-lateral stimulated horizontal borehole plan indicates a continuous drill-string operating torque of 42 kN*m sustained under continuous load by the top-drive rotating system.
WELL-TORQ-81F：Telemetry for the Deviated doublet deep borehole plan records a continuous drill-string operating torque of 68 kN*m sustained under continuous load by the top-drive rotating system.
WELL-TORQ-1LA：Telemetry for the Cascaded tri-well vertical borehole plan documents a continuous drill-string operating torque of 55 kN*m sustained under continuous load by the top-drive rotating system.
